sehemu: Part III: Procedure, Powers and Privileges of Parliament
maudhui: (1) The President shall address the new Parliament at its first meeting and formally open that Parliament. (2) Without prejudice to subarticle (1), the President may at any time address Parliament or send to Parliament a message which shall be read by a Minister.
vifungu: (1) The President shall address the new Parliament at its first meeting and formally open that Parliament.
(2) Without prejudice to subarticle (1), the President may at any time address Parliament or send to Parliament a message which shall be read by a Minister.
